name: Iris Interoperability Specification
// MARK: - VERSION: Emitted as I2S::kVersionMajor / kVersionMinor. Every version group in spec/i2s_keys.json must be at or below this version. Append-only -- ensure a bump never invalidates a file written under an earlier one.
// MARK: - REVISION HISTORY: One entry per version, oldest first, rendered into the specification document.

revisions.summary: Initial draft. Defines the key schema (name, short name, DICOM counterpart, value type, DICOM VR, multiplicity, identity class, PHI flag), the value types, the DICOM value representations a value is written as, and the identity classes, and seeds the Digital Image Identifier (DII) with its PHI flag DII_is_PHI (absent means PHI) and the scanner's identity (manufacturer, model, serial number, software versions, unique device identifier) and the scan time (ScanTime); the serial number, the unique device identifier and the scan time are under review as possible identifiers.
